title: 第86章 岩浆内的结界第85章 藏在炼丹炉内的仙人残魂
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“道友出来吧，别躲藏了，躲得了一时也躲不了一辈子。”
又是半步炼虚境。
躲到岩浆深处的石泉水探查到进来的修士实力，抱着昏迷的邬七巧一路往下。
“主人，只要他进来，主人就可以伺机解决了他。但这样一来，外面的人就会感知到。”
“走一步算一步吧，逃不出去只能拼了。”
石泉水还要去找霓羽和阿叶。
不可能闭关几十年。1-
“主人，继续往前，好像快到了。”
石泉水感觉到脚下有活的东西，立刻停下。
“金蛇，你感觉到什么，我勉强感觉有什么东西在四周盘旋。”
“从岩浆流向看，不是活物，会不会是魂魄一类？”
“哟，原来跑到岩浆里了，害得我好找。”
石泉水不敢耽搁，继续前行。
“主人，他的速度越来越快，很快就能追上主人，外面又有人下来，跟他的实力都差不多。”
“我好像在转圈。”
“转圈？主人不会吧。”
“不，我的确在转圈。得到雨泽的修为后，我的身体达到了一个非常特殊的警戒，对四周的灵气流动极为敏感。就像这里，我能分辨出我自己刚才留下的灵力。”
“主人意思是让他们陷入此地？”
石泉水沉心静气，感受此地的灵气流动方向。
须臾之后，他抱紧邬七巧快速下坠。

在他的感知中，有一条灵气流动一直通向深处。
其余的灵气都困在方寸之间。
“生即死，死即生。前辈在这里布置了法阵，如果我不知感受到灵气流动，也不会以为必死之地。”
“主人，什么是必死之地？我好像没有看到危险，难道是刚才感受到的......”
说话之间，石泉水已经进入了必死之地。
他和邬七巧周围的护身禁制都快承受不住岩浆的攻击。
“主人，怎么停下了？”
“你信不信我会死在此地？”
“主人，你干什么......”
金蛇还没劝说的时候，石泉水撤去了他和邬七巧身上的禁制。
他们的身体在岩浆的攻击之下，迅速燃烧。
content_en:
"Fellow Taoist, come out. Stop hiding. You can hide for a while but you can't hide for a lifetime."
Another half-step to the Void Refining Realm.
Shi Quanshui, who hid deep in the magma, detected the strength of the monks who came in, and carried the unconscious Wu Qiqiao all the way down.
"Master, as long as he comes in, Master can wait for an opportunity to kill him. But in this case, people outside will sense it."
"Just take it one step at a time. If you can't escape, you have to fight."
Shi Quanshui also wants to find Ni Yu and A Ye.
It is impossible to stay in seclusion for decades. 1-
"Master, keep going forward, it seems we are almost there."
Shi Quanshui felt something alive under his feet and stopped immediately.
"Golden Snake, what do you feel? I can barely feel something hovering around."
"Judging from the direction of the magma flow, it's not a living thing. Could it be a soul?"
"Oh, it turned out that it ran into the lava, making it difficult for me to find it."
Shi Quanshui didn't dare to delay and continued moving forward.
"Master, his speed is getting faster and faster, and he will soon catch up with the master. There are people coming down outside, who are about the same strength as him."
"I seemed to be spinning in circles."
"Twirl in circles? Master can't do that, right?"
"No, I am indeed spinning in circles. After gaining Yuze's cultivation, my body has reached a very special alert and is extremely sensitive to the flow of spiritual energy around me. Just like here, I can distinguish the spiritual energy I left behind just now."
"Master, do you mean to let them get stuck here?"
The stone spring water calms down and feels the direction of the spiritual energy flowing here.
After a moment, he hugged Wu Qiqiao tightly and fell quickly.
In his perception, there was a flow of spiritual energy that led all the way to the depths.
The rest of the spiritual energy is trapped in a small space.
"Life is death, death is life. Senior has set up a magic circle here. If I didn't know how to feel the flow of spiritual energy, I wouldn't have thought that I would die."
"Master, what is a place of death? I don't seem to see the danger. Could it be that I just felt it..."
As he spoke, Shiquanshui had already entered the place of death.
The protective barriers around him and Wu Qiqiao could hardly withstand the attack of magma.
"Master, why did you stop?"
"Do you believe that I will die here?"
"Master, what are you doing..."
Before Jin Snake could persuade him, Shiquanshui removed the restrictions on him and Wu Qiqiao.
Their bodies burned quickly under the attack of magma.
